ref_epoch_note: Gaia DR3 epoch J2016.0 = MJD 57388.5 (TCB; the 0.5 d offset from the contract's 57388.0 is negligible).

targets.name: Barnard's Star
targets.ref: Gaia DR3 (gaiadr3.gaia_source, ESA Gaia Archive TAP)
targets.note: Fastest proper motion in a 5' cone (10.39"/yr). K ~ 4.5: core expected to saturate.

targets.name: Epsilon Indi B
targets.ref: Gaia DR3 (gaiadr3.gaia_source, ESA Gaia Archive TAP)
targets.note: Ba+Bb unresolved in Gaia and SPHEREx (<1" apart). Epsilon Indi A (G ~ 4.3) is ~7' away.

targets.name: WISE 0855−0714
targets.note: Not in Gaia. ra/dec moved linearly from the HST anchor (MJD 57474.62) to J2016.0 with the published proper motion; the anchor includes that date's parallax offset (<= 0.45"). Expected only in D5-D6.

targets.name: RW Aurigae
targets.ref: Gaia DR3 (gaiadr3.gaia_source, ESA Gaia Archive TAP)
targets.note: RW Aur A (G 12.18). RW Aur B (Gaia DR3 156430817820015232, G 13.04, RUWE 16) is 1.4" away: one blend at SPHEREx's 6.15" pixels.

targets.name: R Draconis
targets.ref: Gaia DR3 (gaiadr3.gaia_source, ESA Gaia Archive TAP)
targets.note: Mira variable (G 6.37 in DR3). Near the north ecliptic pole: many visits expected.
